_about: AI-assisted: researched and assembled with ChatGPT (OpenAI). See docs/AI_USAGE.md. Historical case/report-date snapshots only. The 2016 appellate article headline says 30 but prints 31 names; four names were held for identity or age ambiguity. Case-scoped organizations denote proceedings, not proven membership in the wider Camorra clan. Individual drug types are left blank for the Mondragone defendants because the sources identify drugs at case level, not per person. No current location, routes, enforcement weaknesses or unlicensed portraits.

sources.title: Droga nella villa comunale: 33 arresti contro gruppo Fragnoli-Gagliardi
sources.claim: Pupia News describes a specific 2012 drug-trafficking association investigation in Mondragone and names the arrestees individually; this case group is separate from the broader Camorra clan.

sources.title: Arrestato Fabio Celentano per associazione finalizzata al traffico e allo spaccio di droga
sources.publisher: Polizia di Stato, Questura di Salerno
sources.claim: The Salerno police report individually identifies Fabio Celentano and says a 22 March 2016 Naples appellate judgment, now final as of 8 June 2017, imposed 14 years 8 months for drug-trafficking association and drug offenses involving cocaine.

sources.title: Detienen en Lloret a un ‘narco’ que formaba parte de la mafia calabresa
sources.claim: El País reports that Guardia Civil arrested Gabriele Biondo in Lloret de Mar on cocaine-trafficking allegations, and describes him as directing an alleged trafficking organization from Spain. Arrest allegations are not a conviction.

sources.title: STC 3/2019, recurso de amparo de Gabriele Biondo
sources.publisher: Boletín Oficial del Estado / Tribunal Constitucional de España
sources.claim: The Constitutional Court records that Spanish drug proceedings concerning the Adamas seizure were provisionally discontinued as to Biondo on 2 November 2016; it partially granted his extradition appeal on 14 January 2019. Neither is a drug conviction.

sources.title: Catturato dalla Polizia di Stato il fornitore di droga della movida dei Navigli a Padova
sources.publisher: Polizia di Stato, Questura di Padova
sources.claim: Padua police individually identify 26-year-old Riccardo Rizzo, report a final five-year conviction for possession of drugs for distribution, and state he was arrested with Marco Marchetti in June 2016 in the Padua drug case. The source does not assign each substance found in the joint search to Rizzo individually.

source.title: Catturato dalla Polizia di Stato il fornitore di droga della movida dei Navigli a Padova
source.publisher: Polizia di Stato, Questura di Padova
source.claim: Padua police individually identify 26-year-old Riccardo Rizzo, report a final five-year conviction for possession of drugs for distribution, and state he was arrested with Marco Marchetti in June 2016 in the Padua drug case. The source does not assign each substance found in the joint search to Rizzo individually.

connections.label: Reported close association in case group

sources.title: Castel Volturno, arrestato Gino Forte dei muzzoni attiguo al clan Fragnoli-Gagliardi-Pagliuca
sources.claim: The report explicitly says investigators established Gino Forte’s closeness to Alessandro Sbordone in the Mondragone group; this is a reported association, not a kinship claim.
